observation_indicators.observable_fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Ibahagi ang nasuring essential-care message, magpa-teach-back, at iugnay sa provider kung may concern.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Gives a current reviewed message and recognizes a referral trigger.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Balewalain ang iniuulat na pagbabago dahil normal daw sa lahat ng sanggol.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Dismiss a reported change as normal for every newborn.

levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nagawa ang pangunahing hakbang ngunit kailangan ng paalala o pagwawasto sa pag-follow-up.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the main step but needs a prompt or correction on follow-up.

levels.hindi_pa_en: Dismiss a reported change as normal for every newborn.
